summary: I read the diff and claims.json, and I ran the site build, cargo test, clippy and fmt in the snapshot. The change does what the retry asked for. Start here has a new "When things go wrong, and what is not limited" list. It says lock contention and an unreadable capacity both exit 1, a failed relaunch restores the record, no relaunch or deferral bound was found, no retry limit is stated for a failed close, and the captain has no deadline. The t2, t5, t7 and t8 summaries now say the same. Merge authority is now "the configured merge authority". The 'ship' and 'captain' entries were rewritten and an 'exit 1' entry was added. Transitions t5, t7 and t8 now show "No guard applies". Every changed fact cites an existing claim (c3, c4, c7, c8, c9, c11, c14, c15, c19, c20) whose text supports it. The CHANGELOG gives source paths and lines and says the quote test runs only when pinned-source/ is mounted. Two new tests cover the guard rendering and the real study page. The site build exited 0, the snapshot stayed unchanged, and tests, clippy and fmt all passed. One deviation: criterion 5 asks for `--out` inside the working directory, but the tool refuses that by design (the fix from the earlier job), so I used the default output in the cargo target directory. I found no blocker or major issue, only two minor wording points.
